definitions.gloss: polite counter for people; persons (in a party)
definitions.explanation: The honorific version of the counter {名|めい}, used by restaurant, hotel, and shop staff when counting guests and customers. It is service-industry language: staff say it about customers, and customers do not use it about themselves.

examples.japanese: {何名様|なんめいさま}です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
{三名様|さんめいさま}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ご⟦{予約|よやく}→予約：01522_yoyaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{承|うけたまわ}りました→承る：04005_uketamawaru⟧。
examples.english: We have your reservation for three people.

examples.japanese: {二名様|にめいさま}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧お{待|ま}ち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦お{客様|きゃくさま}→お客様：08780_okyakusama⟧、⟦カウンター→カウンター：10816_kauntaa⟧⟦{席|せき}→席：02215_seki⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦どうぞ→どうぞ：02920_douzo⟧。
examples.english: Customers waiting as a party of two, please come to the counter seats.

notes:
The counter {名|めい} plus the honorific ⟦{様|さま}→様：01549_sama⟧. Numbers attach directly in front: {一名様|いちめいさま}, {二名様|にめいさま}, {四名様|よんめいさま}.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {何名様|なんめいさま}です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧: how many people are in your party?
- {何名様|なんめいさま}でしょう⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧: the softer, more polite version staff usually say
- ご⟦{一緒|いっしょ}→一緒：02848_issho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{何名様|なんめいさま}: how many are with you?
- {二名様|にめいさま}ご⟦{案内|あんない}→案内：01291_annai⟧: showing a party of two to their table

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {名|めい}: counter for people — plain and formal; used in writing and about your own group ({三名|さんめい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{伺|うかが}います)
- ⟦{人|にん}→〜人：00658_nin⟧: counter for people — the everyday counter, with the irregular ⟦{一人|ひとり}→一人：00630_hitori⟧ and ⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧
- {人前|にんまえ}: portions — counts servings of food, not people
